milestones.title: M0 · Foundations
milestones.description: Repo, decisions, schemas, spikes. Nothing runs agents yet.

milestones.title: M1 · Mini-conductor MVP
milestones.description: One repo, one mini-conductor, real workers via adapters, worktrees, verification. Usable standalone.

milestones.title: M2 · Conductor & escalation
milestones.description: Global conductor, multi-repo registry, decision inbox, summary packets.

milestones.title: M3 · Context handoff & cost tiering
milestones.description: Token-budget-driven fresh-session handoffs, model tiers, escalation ladder, cost ledger.

milestones.title: M4 · Visual & terminal UI
milestones.description: Web app (board, inbox, live terminals, cost) and TUI mode.

milestones.title: M5 · Channels & workflows
milestones.description: Notifications, chat channels, phone access, non-code workflows and templates.

milestones.title: M6 · Ecosystem & hardening
milestones.description: Plugins, A2A/ACP exposure, sandboxing, evals, docs, release.

issues.title: Repo scaffold: pnpm monorepo, TS, lint, test, CI
issues.body:
Set up the monorepo skeleton described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5.

### Tasks
- [ ] pnpm workspaces with packages: core, conductor, mini, adapters/*, web, tui, cli
- [ ] TypeScript strict, shared tsconfig, ESLint + Prettier (or Biome)
- [ ] Vitest, GitHub Actions CI on Linux + macOS (+ Windows smoke)
- [ ] LICENSE (decide: Apache-2.0 vs MIT), CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SECURITY

### Acceptance criteria
- `pnpm i && pnpm test` passes in CI on a clean checkout

_See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/RESEARCH.md for context._

issues.title: ADR-001: Build standalone vs extend Omnigent vs interop
issues.body:
Decide the build-vs-extend question in docs/RESEARCH.md §9 before significant code is written.

### Tasks
- [ ] Run Omnigent locally; try modelling a mini-conductor as an Omnigent agent + policies
- [ ] Run Gas Town on a toy repo; note what to borrow and what to avoid
- [ ] Write ADR with decision, consequences and what we borrow

### Acceptance criteria
- ADR merged in docs/adr/

_See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/RESEARCH.md for context._

issues.title: ADR-002: Language/runtime (TypeScript on Node vs Bun vs Python)
issues.body:
Confirm runtime. Default recommendation: TypeScript on Node (all target SDKs are first-class in TS).

### Tasks
- [ ] Check SDK support matrix: Claude Agent SDK, Codex app-server TS schema, ACP SDK, OpenCode SDK, MCP SDK, AG-UI
- [ ] Check node-pty / PTY support on macOS, Linux, Windows
- [ ] Decide Node vs Bun

### Acceptance criteria
- ADR merged

_See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/RESEARCH.md for context._

issues.title: ADR-003: Wire protocols (conductor↔mini, UI events, MCP surface)
issues.body:
Ratify the protocol table in RESEARCH.md §4: JSON-RPC over local WebSocket shaped like A2A tasks; AG-UI-style UI events; MCP tools for agents.

### Tasks
- [ ] Define message envelope, versioning and auth token handshake
- [ ] Map our Task model onto A2A Task to keep a clean upgrade path
- [ ] Pick AG-UI event subset for UI

### Acceptance criteria
- ADR merged; JSON Schema stubs in @tacet/core

_See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/RESEARCH.md for context._
